gates.description: Complete producer parity is required only for T0-reachable registrations, registrations added or modified by this authority wave, registrations whose producer semantics change here in a way that affects event emission, payload, version source, or atomic outbox boundary, and registrations classified T0_BLOCKER or SAME_WAVE_COHERENCE. Other unresolved registrations may remain as DEFERRED_EVENT_REGISTRY_DEBT with event-specific Q1-Q5 proof.

details.expected: Require complete producer parity only for every T0-reachable registration; every registration added or modified by this authority wave; every registration whose producer semantics change here in a way that affects event emission, payload, version source, or atomic outbox boundary; and every T0_BLOCKER or SAME_WAVE_COHERENCE registration. Every other unresolved registration must remain explicit DEFERRED_EVENT_REGISTRY_DEBT with its own Q1-Q5 proof. Editing a producer contract alone does not promote unrelated event registrations.
